text:
incident-bot: Pager: api-ingress error rate > 8% for 3m (502/504 spike) — auto-page on-call
alice: oncall here, joining now
ben: seeing spike concentrated in eu-west-1 edge muxes, fanout to gateways high
carla: any recent deploys? checking CI/CD history
ben: last deploy was 20m ago, config flip for mux routing (canary)
alice: pulling top upstream errors from logs
ben: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T01:15:12Z ERROR 502 upstream read timeout from 10.20.3.45: upstream reset
2026-03-17T01:15:13Z ERROR 504 gateway timeout upstream service-similarity
```
carla: that upstream svc-similarity shows connection pool exhaustion metrics spiking
dan: i'm next on the rotation, @alice handing off — have the runbook?
alice: Handing to @dan — runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/gw-502s (short checklist)
eve: FYI support loop: 12 customer reports in last 10m, top complain: "responses failing intermittently"
ben: metric breakdown: 62% of 502s from svc-similarity pods behind node pool gpustack-3
carla: can we isolate traffic away from gpustack-3 via routing policy?
dan: starting traffic shift: mark route weight 0 for gpustack-3, move to fallback pool (non-gpu)
alice: enabling short-circuit fallback to smaller model variant for embedded requests to reduce upstream load
ben: applying k8s drain to problematic node now: `kubectl drain node/gpustack-3a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
carla: enabling circuit-breaker on proxy for svc-similarity: maxConns=50, pendingRequests=100
dan: increased upstream connection limit and turned on jittered retries (2 retries, 50-150ms)
alice: initiating pod recycle for svc-similarity (will respect PDB)
ben: observed error rate down from 9.8% -> 6.1% in us-east after shift
eve: customer-impact update: ~15% of calls in eu-west affected over last 10m, CS informed, status page draft started
carla: adding anomaly tag to telemetry: "gpustack-3-conn-exhaust" and creating ticket ENG-502-291011
dan: will monitor for 15m, if stable plan to revert traffic rules gradually
alice: oncall handoff note: if errors don't fall under 5% in 15m, escalate to infra lead @carla
incident-bot: On-call transfer: @alice -> @dan for incident lead (timestamp 2910111245)
ben: kept an eye on latency — 95p latency climbed from 180ms -> 1.2s pre-mitigation
carla: post-mitigation checks: readiness probes fine, downstream queue length normalized
dan: confirmed gpustack-3a drained, kube rescheduled pods to fallback pool, no immediate OOMs
eve: support: posting interim status to affected customers, linking workaround (retry with jitter)
alice: quick note: we saw a pattern of large batch windows correlating with the 502 bursts — follow-up: throttle batch sizes for next release
carla: created post-incident ticket for batching/connection-pool tuning and improved rollout gating
dAn: typo: just realized — I'll own the deploy rollback if necessary
dan: deployment rollback not needed yet, keeping current traffic steering
ben: error rate now at 3.9% globally, eu-west at 4.7%
eve: continuing customer notifications, will update status page in 5m
alice: thanks all — leaving detailed logs in incident doc (internal) and handing to @dan for next watch window :thumbsup:
dan: taking watch, will ping if anything regresses
incident-bot: Incident incident-2910111222 transitioned to monitoring (SEVERITY: HIGH -> MONITORING)
